name: Brotherhood
overview: Scripture reveals that brotherhood is a sacred bond rooted in unity, love, and mutual support among believers. It is described as good and pleasant when brethren dwell together in harmony, reflecting the oneness of God who created all (Psalms 133:1; Malachi 2:10). True brotherhood is demonstrated through steadfast love in adversity and practical help in times of need, embodying Christ's command to love one another as He has loved us (Proverbs 17:17; Ecclesiastes 4:10; John 13:34-35). This love is the identifying mark of Christ’s disciples and a fulfillment of the covenant relationship among God's people.
